note: Always-on cost as printed by `claude plugin details tamirs-superpowers`: the name, description and when_to_use of every skill and agent, paid by every session before any skill fires (hooks and MCP tool schemas are not counted). The official marketplace highlights a plugin's context cost to users once always-on reaches 2,000 tokens. This plugin measured 8,279 on 2026-10-17, so the ceiling is pinned at the measured figure rounded up to the next 500 rather than lowered by trimming descriptions in the same change; 2,000 is the figure to drive down to. Lower the ceiling as the cost comes down; never raise it without updating this note. Refresh always_on_tokens/measured_on/measured_at with `bash scripts/check-token-budget.sh --update`.
